priorWarnings.resolution: All existing combinations retained as independent cases without increasing timeouts; current hosted outcome is recorded above.
Explicit hydration, fonts and frame readiness; no assertion or timeout removed.
Current regression and closure results supersede unconfirmed earlier observations for this execution tree.
Isolated short temporary profile directories preserve real restart/backup behavior.
Observed development client failure; production build/server verified. No unrelated toolchain change.
Initial route evidence retained; the identical failed route passed in a fresh browser with every asset/axe/geometry assertion unchanged. The exact-build report validates all 702 current routes.

Initial 701/702 with shared-index net::ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE; identical fresh-browser restore route passes every original assertion. Raw failure/trace retained and separate validator accepts all 702 exact-build records.

Original and unchanged-repeat CI verification jobs reached 30 minutes; unsharded WebKit/Firefox reached 40 minutes. All cancelled evidence is retained and is not counted as passing. Firefox also printed five timeout and one failure markers, which require the separately recorded named-case diagnosis. Two dedicated CI Chromium shards and four shards per matrix engine retain every test and assertion, two workers, all thresholds/budgets and original job/test timeouts. Final complete results are recorded in hosted counts.
The separate page bypassed the fixture; setInputFiles could set a disabled pre-hydration input. Added readyForUi after each separate-page navigation; both exact portability cases pass.

priorWarnings.item: Food retry quantity before data readiness
priorWarnings.resolution: Trace fill began at 862696ms while the retried asset completed at 862707ms. Three unchanged isolated runs passed; an explicit loaded-profile assertion and retained-quantity assertion now precede preview checks.

integrity.historicalReports: Generated content-completion output is preserved in ignored evidence and original historical tracked reports retained.

limitations: Windows Firefox cannot launch on this host; distinguish it from hosted Linux results.
The development server exhibited a client AsyncLocalStorage bundling failure; production server is verified.
The existing Vite raw chunk-size advisory remains; unchanged gzip budgets pass.
Diagrams are approximate navigation/application workflows, not scientific anatomy or exercise technique.
Physical-device, human assistive-technology and source-review boundaries remain those of the existing release; no new certification is claimed.

Large Windows route crawls can encounter shared-asset ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE. Each observed case retains its raw failure, passes an unchanged fresh-browser replay, and must satisfy the complete current-build route-record validator.

PROG-001.rootCause: UTC ISO digits were used as local datetime defaults, then parsed as local time on save
PROG-001.fix: Local numeric calendar components, shared across four measurement forms; local date uses the same formatter
PROG-001.edit: Existing offset-bearing JSON timestamp edits retain validation and persist after reload
PROG-001.existingRecords: Historical timestamps are not automatically shifted; original intent cannot be inferred. Owners who accepted an old default can review known affected records against their own notes.

PROG-002.rootCause: Last IndexedDB key-order item was treated as the latest measurement
PROG-002.fix: Schema-valid active height by measuredAt instant descending
tieOrder: stable code-point ID only for an otherwise exact tie
PROG-002.future: Retained; eligible on the next read/render after the measurement instant
